A single swing of this giant, sturdy leaf can create a gust of wind strong enough to blow away light objects. These will sometimes fall off trees as they're chopped down.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 1 |durability = 25 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Korok Leaf}} Korok Leaves can occasionally be found lying on the ground near [[Raft]]s, though they can also be found from felling [[Tree]]s. Though they are naturally occurring, they belong to the [[Korok Gear]] archetype of equipment.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 172}} When swung, Korok Leaves produce a strong gust of [[Wind]] that can blow back light [[Enemy|Enemies]], such as [[Bokoblin]]s and [[Yiga Footsoldier]]s. This gust is also useful against Wind-sensitive objects such as windmills and Rafts, allowing Link to sail independently from chance [[Wind]]s. The gust from Korok Leaves can also be used to fan flames, quickly spreading [[Fire]]s. Korok Leaves are flammable and can be used to transfer flames. However, they will disintegrate if left ablaze for too long. Swinging a Korok Leaf without hitting a solid object will not damage its durability. As Korok Leaves are not designed to be used as [[Weapon]]s, they are not optimal for direct melee combat. Nonetheless, they are still capable of dealing minor damage. Korok Leaves cannot be thrown, as Link will merely blow a gust of Wind if the [[R Button]] is held and released. Charging an attack with a Korok Leaf will cause Link to forcefully thrust it forward from overhead, generating a longer-lasting gust of Wind. Gusts from a Korok Leaf can upset [[Cucco]]s, prompting them to attack if sufficiently agitated. During the "[[Recital at Warbler's Nest]]" [[Shrine Quest]], [[Kheel]] will give Link a Korok Leaf as a reward if he does not already have one.{{Cite|Oh! And I almost forgot! I got you a little something. Just a small thanks for bringing all of my sisters here.|Kheel|BotW}} She suggests that he swing it towards the stone structures the make up [[Warbler's Nest]], as it makes a fun noise when he does so.{{Cite|{{Big|Ta-da! A {{Color BotW|Red|Korok Leaf}}!}} Why don't you swing it in the direction of {{Color BotW|Red|Warbler's Nest}}? It makes a fun noise!|Kheel|BotW}} She also shares the lyrics to the song they are singing, which describes a [[Monk]] throwing open the doors if the Wind makes the rocks sing.{{Cite|Now we can rehearse here at {{Color BotW|Red|Warbler's Nest}}! Want to know what song we're singing? Well...the {{Color BotW|Blue|elder}} told me... It's a song passed down in the Rito Village that was once sung at {{Color BotW|Red|Warbler's Nest}} in ancient times. If you didn't know, {{Color BotW|Red|Warbler's Nest}} is the big stone platform with the pillars behind us. The lyrics don't make a lot of sense, but there's one line in particular that always catches my ear... "When wind convinces the rocks to sing, open the monk's door will swing."|Kheel|BotW}} If Link swings his Korok Leaf at these structures in the correct order while standing on the nearby [[Pedestal]], [[Voo Lota Shrine]] will emerge from the ground, completing the Shrine Quest.{{Cite|You solved the mystery behind the Rito Village song and Warbler's nest, uncovering an ancient shrine in the process!|Adventure Log|BotW}} Korok Leaves will burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or equipped in a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_056" |Life = 25 |Power = 1 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = true |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = false |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 0 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 2 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 0 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 0 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.0 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 1.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 112 |BuyingPrice = 450 }} ==Trivia== * An unused icon and description for Korok Leaves exist within the files of {{AoC}}.{{Cite Internal|quote= A single swing of this giant, sturdy leaf can create a gust of wind strong enough to blow away light objects.
